scattered.execution: Rerun against clean installed 0.7.1 wheel after source tests; QA environment recycled after success.

baseline_counts.reason: Required local reverse-stencil grid vertices lie outside the source hull. No extrapolation or nearest fill is applied.

scattered.conclusion: Point count coverage, grid node fraction, nodal-quadrature mass and geometric area differ. Compare errors on common support; inverse stencils must not cross declared or missing source regions.

saved_npz.conclusion: Saved coverage and width are arithmetically correct. 24/30 is below the target but too small to establish stable 90% deployment coverage; the two-sided 95% binomial interval includes 90%. More independent calibration and future truth are needed, without adjusting the band on these test residuals.

protocol.fixed_model: Full DCT2 + ridge(alpha=0.01), fitted once on proper training, without candidate selection, CV, HPO or refitting after calibration.
protocol.truth: Linear mean field plus independent Gaussian noise per coordinate, sigma=0.08 for x<0 and 0.35 otherwise; channel 2 numeric scale is 10 times channel 1.

uncertainty.conclusion: Saved arithmetic correct. Independent repeated calibration/future experiments support finite-sample marginal behavior; fixed widths do not adapt to difficult conditions or noise shifts. Pointwise does not ensure whole-field coverage.

boundary_example.interpretation: Uniform nonzero inlet/outlet velocity is valid input and belongs to exact, not harmonic, on a simply connected rectangle. No boundary flux was prescribed to a PDE solver.

coexact_lift_boundary.interpretation: Weak native edge balance does not impose pointwise normal node velocity after lifting.

node_sampling_nullspace.interpretation: Alternating node pattern is invisible to edge endpoint averages and remains sampling_residual, not harmonic.

vector_rect.reason: hodge requires nonperiodic geometry; use helmholtz for periodic vector projection

hodge.conclusion: Finite-cochain natural convention verified numerically on manufactured fields and all 400 compatible retained synthetic fields. No pointwise impermeable/PDE boundary condition is imposed; topology and energy depend on raster geometry.
